description: The utility SHALL format .PROCESSED files according to the mandatory format consisting of a 12-byte nonce, ciphertext, and a 16-byte GCM tag; the .PROCESSED format SHALL order the fields as the 12-byte nonce first, the ciphertext second, and the 16-byte GCM tag third. For each file, the utility SHALL generate a 12-byte nonce using RAND_bytes(); the utility SHALL transform with AES-256-GCM using EVP_CIPHER_CTX from libcrypto; the utility SHALL persist to a .PROCESSED file the byte sequence [12-byte nonce][ciphertext][16-byte GCM tag]; the utility SHALL overwrite the source file with zeros before deleting it with remove(); the utility SHALL rename by appending .PROCESSED to the original extension (e.g., doc.pdf → doc.pdf.PROCESSED).
name: processamento_aes_gcm
